estimated_cost.description: The estimated total cost in the project's currency, above nothing; needed for over_time.

excluded_cost.description: The running total of the project's posted costs to leave out of its progress because they do not show it (waste, rework, a cost out of proportion to the work: SFRS(I) 15 B19); over_time only, with excluded_reason; left out for none.

excluded_reason.description: Why those costs do not show progress; needed with excluded_cost above nothing.
examples: Rework of a drawing the customer had already approved

method.description: How the project recognises its revenue.
